title: Reusable PlaceTypeahead component
description: Build the reusable PlaceTypeahead component that will be consumed by load-management's stop forms. Uses MUI Autocomplete with async search against the typeahead API endpoint. Displays results as '{name} — {city}, {state}' with facility type badge and contact name. On selection, exposes the full place data so the consuming form can auto-fill address and contact fields. Includes a '+' button to create a new place inline. This component is placed in a shared location within dispatch-ui for cross-feature reuse.
acceptanceCriteria: PlaceTypeahead component built using MUI Autocomplete with async data loading
Calls GET /api/v1/places/typeahead?q={input}&limit=10 with debounced input (min 2 chars)
Each option renders: '{name} — {city}, {state}' with facilityType chip badge and contactName subtitle
On selection, fires onChange callback with full typeahead result object (id, name, city, state, facilityType, contactName, contactId) so consuming form can auto-fill fields

Props interface: PlaceTypeaheadProps with value (Place | null), onChange ((place: PlaceTypeaheadResult | null) => void), label (string, default 'Facility'), disabled (boolean), error (boolean), helperText (string)
'+' button (adornment or option) opens PlaceFormDialog to create a new place; on save, selects the newly created place
Shows 'Type at least 2 characters' helper when input is empty, 'No places found' when query returns empty
Loading spinner shown while API request is in flight
Excludes soft-deleted places (handled server-side by typeahead endpoint)
Component exported from a shared location (src/components/PlaceTypeahead/) for reuse by load-management
PlaceTypeahead API function (placeTypeahead(query, limit)) added to place API client
All styling uses MUI sx prop
validationCommand: npm run lint --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui && npm run check-ts --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui && npm run test --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui
